physiologic response to meet greater body demands

degree AV block, symptomatic ≥5sec pause in AFIB
: abnormality in SA node action potential generation or conduction
➁ Alternating bradycardia & atrial tachyarrhythmias (tachy-brady syndrome)
➂ Sinus pause/arrest: sinus pause >3s = sinus arrest (+/- escape rhythm)
▪︎Type I: progressively shorter P-P intervals followed by dropped P wave
▪︎Type II: pauses in sinus rhythm that are multiples of basic sinus rates
➄ Chronotropic incompetence: inability to ⇡ HR to match demand from ⇡ activity
: sinus node degeneration & fibrosis; often involves other parts of conduction system
: BBs, non-DHP CCBs, digoxin, antiarrhythmics, AChE inhibitors (donepezil, rivastigmine)
: rheumatic fever, pericarditis, diphtheria, Chagas disease
: SA nodal artery disease, cardiac trauma, hypothyroidism
Often asymptomatic at first w/ symptoms developing over time
exercise intolerance, fatigue, dizziness, HA, nausea, palpitations, CP, SOB, syncope
